parole.significato: A member of a minor biblical tribe mentioned in Nahum 1:1.

parole.significato: To stew; to be stifled or suffocated.
parole.testo: From Middle English stīven, alternative form of stūphen (“to steep (meat in a liquid)”), from Vulgar Latin *extuphāre, *extufāre, *extupāre, from ex- + Ancient Greek τύφω (túphō, “to smoke”).
